thread:
zoe (sec-eng): Noticing a spike: SCIM PATCH -> 403 for tenant `orchid` after onboarding. Auth ok but roles missing; logs show KMS InvalidCiphertext.
dan (idp): Paste the snippet?
zoe (sec-eng): sanitized: `2026-04-10T14:01:03Z ERROR provisioner scim PATCH user -> 403 {"detail":"forbidden: decrypt extId failed: InvalidCiphertextException"}` and `DEBUG kms: decrypt failed alias/rdw-provisioner context {"extId":"acct:orchid:eng","meta_v":"2"}`
lee (infra): KMS reject usually means context mismatch or different alias. Any recent metadata changes for Orchid?
zoe (sec-eng): Onboarder auto-updated IdP metadata earlier; vendor included `xmlns =` (space) and a non-breaking space in attribute order. Our canonicalizer bumped meta_v.
dan (idp): That would change the extId content used in encryption context. If some encrypted blobs were produced before the normalization change, decrypt will fail.
lee (infra): Quick mitigation: add decrypt compatibility in provisioner: try current context, then previous meta_v, then try prev key alias. If none succeed, create user with `role=viewer_limited` and emit audit event `scim.provision.fallback` with tenant tag.
zoe (sec-eng): Agreed. Also add an onboarding assert: when metadata update changes canonicalization we should flag meta_v bump and notify idp-platform and sec.
dan (idp): I'll land a small normalization pass to collapse attribute whitespace and run C14N before extId generation to prevent future bumps.
audit-bot: incident INC-2026-0132 created and linked to this thread
zoe (sec-eng): I'll open INC and attach ciphertext samples for backfill. Note: do not rotate KMS keys until backfill completes.
lee (infra): Deploying a canary probe-mode for tenant=orchid (PR #4510). Will monitor scim.provision.fail and scim.provision.fallback metrics for 10m.
dan (idp): After canary, plan: reprocess backlog with compatibility decrypt, re-encrypt extIds to canonical context, then retire legacy ciphertexts.
zoe (sec-eng): Thanks team. Postmortem action items: 1) decrypt-compatibility path 2) XML whitespace tolerant tests in onboarding 3) fallback least-priv role + audit 4) alert on meta_v changes.
